title: Consulate General of India in San Francisco expresses grief over the stabbing of Indian-origin man in Utah
summary: The Indian Consulate in San Francisco has offered assistance to the family of Syed Sohail Uddin, who was stabbed in Utah on Monday evening. The suspect, Peter Micheal Larsen, reportedly attacked Uddin due to his faith.
